label: Every finite selection of the complete infinite-tail Grim…, by Finite-bound-construction-and…
meaning: For any finite tested set choose k strictly above its maximum (using its finite supremum plus one, also for the empty set), and let only index k act. At each tested index both the action and its complete no-earlier-action condition are false, because k is in its tail. Reuse the existing GrimReaperImpossible.grimReaperImpossible theorem for failure of a global assignment. No truncation of any tested tail is used.
